notes:
- Every Iris Client player sees the cape you wear, within a minute or two. No waiting for the owner any more.
- The switch next to SAVE says who sees it: Visible to everyone, or Only you see it.
- GIFs work properly: every frame, its own timing and transparent parts come along, and long GIFs are thinned evenly instead of cut off.
- A cape made from a GIF carries a GIF badge, other moving capes an ANIMATED one, in the studio and in My capes.
- The cards in My capes and the gallery show the cape in 3D and play the animation.
- The gallery shows the cape of every player who shares one, with who wears it.
- The Capes page is calmer: tabs slide in, cards lift when you point at them, and notes fade out on their own.
- Big capes are sent smaller when they would be too large, and the PNGs Iris Client writes are a lot smaller now.
- On Linux and macOS a GIF comes in with every frame, and sharing works the same way.
